Interface Reports

All Known Implementing Classes:
ReportsImpl
public interface Reports
Client interface for the Report Center in the Equinix Customer Portal.

Backed by the Reports v1 API at /v1/reportCenter/reports. Generated reports are listed, retrieved, downloaded and deleted; scheduled report definitions can be listed, created, fetched, updated and deleted; and the available report definitions can be enumerated.

    • deleteReports

      List<? extends Report> deleteReports(List<String> reportIds)
      Deletes generated reports in bulk.

      Maps to DELETE /v1/reportCenter/reports (deleteReports). This is a best-effort bulk delete: the response carries one result per requested report id, each with a reportId and a per-report status (SUCCESS or ERROR), so callers can detect partial failures.

      Parameters:
      reportIds - the report ids to delete
      Returns:
      the per-report delete results
